categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo Solartron Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of specialty functional films including reflective films, optical base films, lithium-ion battery separators, backsheet base films, and other special functional films. These products serve industries such as liquid crystal displays (LCD), semiconductor lighting, lithium battery power and energy storage, and solar photovoltaic. The company also engages in new material technologies and related equipment manufacturing and sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced polyester film biaxial stretching production lines, proprietary formula designs for high reflectivity reflective films, precision coating and composite technologies, and polymer modification processes. It has developed multi-phase microporous structures to enhance reflectivity above 97%, and employs precise control over stretching temperatures, ratios, and heat-setting to optimize film properties. The firm also designs and customizes production lines and equipment to reduce costs and improve efficiency, with core technologies reaching international leading levels.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major global electronics manufacturers such as Samsung, LG, BOE, and other well-known panel and terminal enterprises. The primary markets served are the flat panel display industry (especially LCD TVs and monitors), semiconductor lighting, lithium-ion battery manufacturers for automotive and energy storage applications, and photovoltaic solar energy sectors. The company’s products are critical components in these industries, supporting large-scale applications like TVs, smartphones, and electric vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and multiple subsidiaries located in Ningbo, Shanghai, Hefei, and Zhejiang free trade zones. It also has a wholly-owned subsidiary in Hong Kong for overseas sales. Its products are sold domestically and internationally, with significant export sales to South Korea and other countries, serving global electronics and energy markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ningbo Solartron Technology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, producing specialty functional films and materials that serve as key upstream components for downstream manufacturers of electronic displays, lithium-ion batteries, and photovoltaic modules. It sources raw materials such as polyester chips from petrochemical refiners and supplies processed films to panel makers and battery manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic R&D priorities focus on expanding and enhancing reflective films, optical base films, lithium-ion battery separators, and flexible circuit release films. It emphasizes independent innovation, process optimization, and new product development aligned with emerging technologies like Mini LED, foldable displays, and green materials. The firm aims to achieve import substitution, international leadership, and to develop ten leading functional film products over the next decade, supporting national strategic industries such as new energy vehicles, 5G, semiconductors, and new displays.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of specialty functional films and related products to industrial customers. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by selected distributors to broaden market reach. Income is recognized upon transfer of control of goods to customers, typically after delivery and customer acceptance, with contracts priced based on negotiated terms reflecting product specifications and volumes.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international giants such as Japan’s Toray, Teijin, and Korea’s SKC in the specialty functional film market. Domestically, it faces competition from leading lithium battery separator manufacturers like Enjie and Xingyuan. Ningbo Solartron Technology holds a leading global position in reflective films with the largest shipment area worldwide and is recognized as a top-tier player in optical films and battery separators, progressively narrowing the technology gap with foreign incumbents.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.25 billion, representing an 8.7% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 95.4 million, a 15.9% decrease compared to the previous year, mainly due to increased investment in new product lines such as battery separators. Total assets grew 23.5% to RMB 3.34 billion, and net assets increased 5.2% to RMB 2.18 billion. R&D expenditure rose by 32.3%, accounting for 5.48% of revenue, reflecting a growth-oriented investment profile.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced proprietary technologies, high product quality, and cost-effective manufacturing capabilities as key differentiators. Its reflective films achieve internationally leading reflectivity above 97%, with a comprehensive product portfolio covering all LCD sizes and emerging Mini LED applications. The firm’s ability to design and customize production lines reduces costs and enhances supply stability. It also focuses on green, environmentally friendly materials and supports national strategic industries, positioning itself as a reliable partner for high-end functional film solutions.
